description: For a company canceling its tools or closing: the last day to export from each tool once the account ends, by plan, from what each vendor's own terms say happens after cancellation (export window in days, kept with no export, or nothing). Each row quotes the vendor's words with the date read. With no plan given, the plan with the shortest window is used and flagged. Tool ids as in get_tool_terms.

ends.description: Day the accounts end, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today (UTC).

plans.description: Plan per tool as the vendor spells it, e.g. {"slack": "Pro"}.

tools.description: Tool ids, e.g. ["slack", "google-workspace", "hubspot"]. Omit for every tool.

name: deletion_clock
title: Last day to export from each business tool
